structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a fresh pump.fun copy of "Tung Tung Tung Sahur / TripleT". Its description says "Fees to @mementumlab via UsePaid". Mementum Lab is the IP agency behind the Tung Tung Sahur brainrot meme. So this is a fee-routing token aimed at the IP owner, launched by a serial deployer (GMGN counts 176 launches). It got a quick burst of about $78k volume and peaked near $18k market cap. It has since fallen about 46–52% in the last 5 minutes to about $6k market cap, with sellers outnumbering buyers (68 vs 36 unique in the last 5 minutes). Another TripleT copy (gz1s…pump) launched about 3 minutes earlier. The canonical TripleT (J8PS…pump, about $9M market cap) is the one people actually mean.

narrative.description: The Tung Tung Tung Sahur Italian-brainrot meme with fees routed to Mementum Lab, the IP creator. The meme is real and well known but old. The fee-to-IP-owner angle via UsePaid is a small hook, and I found no sign that Mementum Lab endorses it.
narrative.why_spreading: A brief launch spike driven by the famous name and the fee-to-creator angle, plus bundler and bot flow. Price is already falling hard.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is the fee-routing claim to @mementumlab. I found no evidence that Mementum Lab acknowledges it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Canonical TripleT J8PS…pump (about $9M market cap, $715k liquidity, active volume); a large 47hW… entry; many dead copies; gz1s…pump launched about 3 minutes earlier.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 134 bundler wallets and 84 fresh wallets. The project X account (mystiquexbt) has been renamed 5 times. The creator has 176 launches and a best-ever peak of only $212k. The image appears 71 times elsewhere. RugCheck flags it as a copycat.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts. Mementum Lab could retweet it, which would change the picture.

structural_risks: serial deployer with 176 launches and a recycled X account
low curve progress (about 40 of 115 virtual SOL)

structured_output.counterargument: At about $6k market cap on the curve, a 2x only needs about $12k, which is below the $18k peak it already hit. A retweet from Mementum Lab, or fee-sharing hype, could send it back up fast. Top-10 concentration is low (about 16%) and the creator holds nothing.
unknowns: Whether Mementum Lab acknowledges this token or its fees
The content of the mystiquexbt post
Whether the bundler wallets are still holding

source_coverage.notes: The contract search returned nothing relevant. A name search found the canonical TripleT and Mementum Lab's identity. The UsePaid page failed with an SSL error. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were skipped because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: This is a serial-deployer copycat of a famous meme that is already dumping after its launch spike. It is not the canonical token, and the fee-to-IP angle is unconfirmed. Its low market cap gives some bounce chance, but it ranks below a typical coin in this pool.
